verdict.rationale: Railway's docs claim the CLI supports developing locally before deploying from the terminal, so local development is a first-party capability. Nothing describes a local simulator or emulator that reproduces the production runtime, and there is no evidence of dev/prod parity. Missing for 10: a documented local runtime simulator, evidence of parity with the production environment (networking, variables, services), in-depth docs on the local dev workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
makes it easy to provision infrastructure, develop locally, and deploy to the cloud
